content_sections.heading: About RGCB Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology (BRIC-RGCB) is an organization under the Department of Biotechnology, Government of India. This recruitment drive invites suitable Indian citizens for a temporary position under a BIRAC-DBT project at its Akkulam Campus, Thiruvananthapuram.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification announces one position for Instrumentation and Software Integration Engineer. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following qualification and eligibility criteria:

rows.essential_qualification: Candidates with a B. Tech and/or a master’s degree in Chemistry/ Biochemistry/ Physics/ Optics/ Biotechnology are eligible to apply.
rows.desirable_qualification: Demonstrable experience/internship in an industry is preferred. Qualification in National Eligibility Test - CSIR-UGC NET including Lectureship (Assistant Professorship) or Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE)/ or National Level Examination conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions is preferred but not essential.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive ₹ 50,000/- consolidated per month. The appointment is initially for a period of one year or till termination of the project whichever is earlier and extendable based on the performance evaluation. Selection to the position will not entitle the candidate to any future positions at RGCB (permanent or otherwise). As with all project positions at RGCB, the position will be co terminus with end of the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RGCB Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications should be submitted online. Candidates currently working in Government firms should send applications through proper channel. Ensure completed applications are submitted by November 01, 2026. If a candidate wishes to apply for different positions, separate application forms should be submitted for each position.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants will be short listed for the online selection interview based on eligibility criteria. Selection of suitable candidates will be made based on qualifications and performance in the selection interview.

content_sections.text: Applications which are not in the prescribed format will summarily be rejected. Only those fulfilling the above criteria need apply.
